context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements agent-to-agent communication using ctx.taskClient.sendMessage(), proper subscription to sub-agent results, error handling for unreachable agents, and separate agent-card.json configurations for each agent.

checklist.name: taskClient.sendMessage usage
checklist.description: Translator handler uses ctx.taskClient.sendMessage() to send a task to the reviewer agent

checklist.name: Correct sendMessage params
checklist.description: sendMessage call includes agentName, ownerId (from task.ownerId), and requestParts

checklist.name: Subscribe to sub-agent result
checklist.description: Uses session.onArtifact() and/or session.onTerminal() callbacks to receive reviewer output

checklist.name: Both handlers have correct signature
checklist.description: Both translator and reviewer handlers use default async export with proper types

checklist.name: Separate agent cards
checklist.description: Each agent has its own agent-card.json with distinct agentName values

checklist.name: Error handling for unreachable agent
checklist.description: Translator handles the case where the reviewer agent is not reachable (try/catch or timeout)

checklist.name: Combined JSON result
checklist.description: Translator returns both translation and review as a combined JSON artifact

checklist.name: Reviewer reads requestParts
checklist.description: Reviewer handler reads input from task.requestParts?.[0] properly

checklist.name: reportStatus in both handlers
checklist.description: Both handlers use ctx?.reportStatus() for progress updates

checklist.name: Setup includes running both agents
checklist.description: Setup instructions explain how to start both agents (two separate blocks run commands)
